svg.text: LightLink sign: ESP8266 (D1 mini) to 74HCT245 to panel ribbons
Each 74HCT245 runs on the sign's 5 V: it reads the ESP's 3.3 V signals and drives true 5 V into the panels' HC244 inputs.
pin 1 = triangle on the IDC plug
pin 1 = triangle on the IDC plug
Both 74HCT245s: pin 20 VCC to 5 V, pin 10 GND, pin 1 DIR to 5 V (A to B), pin 19 OE to GND,
100 nF cap from pin 20 to GND at each chip, unused input A8 (pin 9) to GND. All 5 V from the sign PSU, all grounds common.
Ribbon pin 8 stays unconnected. Pins 4 and 7 both get SRCK. Dots = junctions; crossings without a dot don't connect.
